name: Ferryman
tagline: Your public total invites robbery; your secret Charter is where the real money is.
core_loop: On your turn ferry a Dock passenger by paying an equal-or-higher (or buoyant) hand card onto the shared Toll pile, or pay a card to poach the newest passenger off a player whose public total is ahead of yours, or wade a toll card or draw — while quietly stacking the suit of your secret Charter.
win_condition: Most points from the public Shore ledger (per suit: highest full, second half, rest 1 each) plus kin fares, suit majorities and your revealed Charter bonus, minus one per card left in hand.
